description: Salary statistics for an occupation in Norway: median monthly salary for full-time employees, lower and upper quartile and estimated hourly wage (Statistics Norway, SSB), plus the number of open positions on Kollegia and in Norway overall (NAV). With a location, adds the number of open jobs there. Links to the occupation page on kollegia.no. SSB salaries are national, not per location.

location.description: Optional. Norwegian municipality, city district or county, e.g. 'Bergen', 'Tromsø', 'Grünerløkka', 'Vestland', 'Oslo'. Regions like 'Nord-Norge' or 'Vestlandet' also work, and 'hjemmefra' gives remote jobs.
